gaps.desktop: The checklist glyph after 'Buy party decorations' (about 30x22px at x~455) is where the loser falls behind. Its three bullets are drawn as filled, squarish grey blobs about 6px across, so the icon reads as a smudge. The winner draws hollow 6px rings with a ~1.5px stroke and clear white centres, followed by ~12px rules. Redraw the loser's bullets as stroked circles so the icon matches the outlined note glyph beside it. Rows, type, colours and the This Evening header are otherwise pixel-equivalent.
gaps.phone: The rows are pixel-identical, so the add button decides it. The loser's blue '+' button is a flat 66px disc with almost no elevation: its halo fades to white within ~3px. It is pinned only 16px from the right and bottom edges, beside the last row. The winner uses a 63px disc with a soft drop shadow (about 10-12px blur, 2-3px downward offset, ~8% black) and 19px right / 29px bottom insets, so it floats clear of the list. Add that shadow and those insets.

why: Rows, typography, colour and spacing are near-identical at both sizes. The winner wins on small-detail finish: crisp hollow checklist bullets on desktop, and an elevated, properly inset add button on phone.
